name: exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_basicOpen_eq_zero_of_isCompact
statement: Scheme.{u}) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsCompact U.1) (x f : Γ(X, U)) (H : x |_ (X.basicOpen f) = 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n * x = 0

name: Scheme.isNilpotent_iff_basicOpen_eq_bot_of_isCompact
statement: Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (f : Γ(X, U)) : IsNilpotent f ↔ X.basicOpen f = ⊥
